name: drag-items
title: Draggable Reorder List
blurb: Draggable vertical list with smooth reorder animation.
description: A draggable list component using motion/react Reorder for smooth item reordering. Items can be dragged vertically to change order with automatic state management.
use_when: To-do lists, prioritization interfaces, or scenarios where users need to reorder items interactively.
avoid_when: Touch-only devices; drag-based interaction is primary and mouse-dependent.
a11y: Drag-based reordering only; no keyboard navigation or screen-reader announcements for reorder state.
